sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into this match on the back of a WIN, extending their excellent recent form of five consecutive victories before that. Alsager Town arrive in poor shape, languishing in 20th place with just 4 points and a streak of five consecutive defeats, making this a heavily favoured fixture for the hosts.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that carries title-race weight given their 2-point gap to leaders Sandbach. Elsewhere, third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a promising matchup between two top-half sides, while Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) face Wednesfield Community (9th) at home. Bilston Town (6th) travel to Foley Meir (13th) in a mid-table encounter. In the lower reaches, struggling Widnes Town visit Brereton Social (both mid-table), Telford Town host Cheadle Heath Nomads in a battle between two of the division's poorest performers, and Crewe face Allscott Heath. Shawbury United entertain Barnton in a fixture between sides with contrasting recent form, while Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a match between two inconsistent mid-table teams.
